title: Anomaly.Items.Usable
description: Whether the receiving character can use an item number at this moment, for an item that is neither carried nor on the shelf of the shop the character stands in (those carry it in their own snapshots). Answers Anomaly.Request {package:"Anomaly.Items.Usable", num}. A one-time answer, not a subscription: it goes stale when level, alignment, class or race change, so ask again rather than cache it. An item number the realm does not have is answered {num, unknown:true}.

canUse.description: the receiving character, now, by the engine's own check; live, never cached past the next snapshot

cannotUseBecause.description: why the engine's own use check (ItemUsability.CanUse) refuses it, in the order it checks: level (below the minimum or above the maximum), class (the class list), race (the race list), weaponType (the class's weapon type), armourType (armour heavier than the class allows), magical (a Magical item and an anti-magic class), alignment (Good/Evil/Neutral-only, the evil-point minimum, Not-Good, Not-Evil). The engine stops at the first refusal, so this holds one reason; empty when canUse is true
